$comment: The source of sf-chart-line (standard simai.smart-component 1.3.14 in the 1.4 form, vocabulary 1.1.5). The parameters are docs/research/parameters.md of ui-chart, the renderer and the keyboard docs/research/rendering.md, the name and the family docs/DECISIONS.md D2.

label.summary: What the chart shows, in a few words: its accessible name, the table's caption and the file name of an export. Required in practice: without it the chart is named «График».

items.summary: The data: a list of records ([{month, sales}, …]) or an object of columns ({month: [...], sales: [...]}). A missing value (null, '', a word) is a gap, never a zero.

names.summary: What each series is called, by its key: {sales: «Продажи»}. A series without a name is called by its key.

x.summary: The field along the horizontal axis; the first field when unset.

y.summary: The field of the values, or a comma list of fields, one series per field (the wide form); every numeric field when unset.

series.summary: The long form: one series per distinct value of this field, the values from the first y field.

x-scale.summary: auto reads the x values: dates are time, numbers linear, anything else a category in the order given.

y-min.summary: The bottom of the value axis; the data's own when unset.

y-max.summary: The top of the value axis; the data's own when unset.

y-zero.summary: The value axis takes zero in, so a change is seen against the whole and not only against the range.

curve.summary: linear joins the points straight; step holds a value until the next; smooth is a curve that never goes past its points.

area.summary: Fills the ground under each line, lightly, down to zero or the axis bottom.

stack.summary: none: each line from its own values; stacked: the series as layers on one another, each line its layer's top and its area the band under it, positive up and negative down from zero; normalized: the layers as shares of their whole at each x, 0–100 %.

gaps.summary: break: the line stops where a value is missing; connect: it joins the points around the gap.

markers.summary: A dot at each value: auto draws them while there is room (at least 12 px a point), always and none decide.

legend.summary: auto shows the legend above the plot when there are two series or more. Each entry is a button that hides and shows its series.

tooltip.summary: axis: under the pointer or the cursor, every series' value at that x.

grid.summary: Which guide lines the plot draws across it.

x-label.summary: The name of the horizontal axis, said under it; the x field's own name heads the table's first column when unset.

y-label.summary: The name of the value axis, said above it.

x-format.summary: For a time axis: auto, or an Intl date style (short, medium, long, full). For a linear axis: a number format as y-format.

y-format.summary: number, integer, decimal-<n>, percent (a share 0..1), compact or currency-<CODE>, in the page's language.

size.summary: The rung of the size ladder: the plot's height, the text and the gaps. 1/2 for a card, 2 for a page of its own.

table.summary: The same data as a table: toggle offers a button that swaps the plot for it, visible shows it under the plot, hidden keeps it for screen readers only. Never none: the table is the chart's text.

summary.summary: auto: a sentence of what the data does (the range, each series' first and last value, its peak), said before the plot and shown under it for screen readers. The description slot adds the host's own words.

data-state.summary: auto: ready with data, empty without. loading draws the frame without lines; error offers «Повторить», which sends refresh.

decimate.summary: auto: past two points per pixel column a line keeps, per column, its first, lowest, highest and last point, so ten thousand points draw like four hundred and every peak stays.

hidden-series.summary: The keys of the series the person hid with the legend.

toggle.summary: The person hid or showed a series with its legend button; applied at once (the vocabulary's local toggle).

select.summary: The person chose a point: a click on the plot, or Enter or Space on the keyboard cursor.

refresh.summary: The person asked for the data again from the error state; the host loads it and sets items.

reset.summary: Shows every series again and takes the cursor away.

description.$comment: The host's own words about the chart: said with the summary (aria-describedby) and shown under the plot.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16); the plot is SVG drawn with lit's svg tag.

skeleton.$comment: The items arrive after the first paint when the host loads them: the derived skeleton holds the plot's box (its height is the size rung's) until they do (standard 1.3.8 §5.4).

accessibility.x-keys: The plot is one Tab stop (role group, aria-roledescription «график»). Left and Right move the cursor along x, Up and Down across the shown series, Home and End to the ends, Page Up and Page Down a tenth at a time, past 200 points a hundredth; each move is said in a polite live region. Enter and Space choose the point (select); Escape takes the cursor away. The legend entries and the table button are buttons of their own.

x-summary: A line chart: one or more series over time, a number or categories, with axes, a legend that hides series, a tooltip, a keyboard cursor, a summary in words and the same data as a table.
x-decisions: name: sf-chart-line, the Framework's naming rule sf-[set]-<block>[-<variant>], block chart (the owner's decision of 2026-11-02, ui-control control/decisions/2026-11-02-smart-component-naming.md; docs/DECISIONS.md D2), family chart.
data: items with a field mapping x, y, series (D3); records or columns; a missing value is a gap.

renderer: own SVG through lit's svg tag (D5). A line is a path, decimated past two points per pixel column, so it never needs Canvas; Canvas is for per-point marks past 2,000 (bar and scatter charts).

colour: until the Framework's categorical roles --sf-chart-1..8 arrive (ordered, D4), series 1..3 take the primary, secondary and tertiary graphic tones and series 4 on the neutral one with a dash pattern of its own; every series past the first has its own dash in forced colours.
select: the vocabulary's select is {ids} for a list; a point is no entry with an id, so it carries {series, index, x, value}.
table: never none; the default toggle keeps the page short, hidden keeps it for screen readers.
first paint: the frame (axes room, the label, the legend's place) holds its height from the size rung before data or width arrive, so nothing moves when the lines are drawn.
hidden-series: not hidden, which is the browser's own member of every element (§3.1).

stack: stacked areas live on the line chart, not in a chart of their own (D1). A stacked layer always fills its band, whatever area says; layers share their kept points when decimated, so no band leaves a seam; in forced colours a layer is its outlines.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-chart-line for one or more series that change along time or another ordered axis.
do_not: Do not draw a chart without a label
Do not replace missing values with zero
Do not use it for parts of a whole; that is sf-chart-pie or a stacked sf-chart-bar

accessibility.focus: One Tab stop on the plot, then the legend buttons and the table button. The summary is the plot's description; each cursor move is said politely.

$comment: The chart draws its empty and error states as sf-empty-state; a tag it renders is a tag it fetches.
Its own buttons (the legend, the table toggle) are native buttons, so it fetches no sf-button.
